name: blackout-mobile
description: Blackout mobile app - Capacitor wrapper around blackout-web

scripts.preflight: node -e "const [major]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if(major<22){console.error('Node.js 22+ is required for blackout-mobile'); process.exit(1)}; console.log('Node', process.versions.node, 'ok')"
scripts.dev: pnpm preflight && pnpm build:web && echo 'Web bundle built. Run: pnpm sync:android or pnpm sync:ios (after platform setup)'
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release archive
scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
